plugins.name: panma-harness
plugins.description: Multi-agent supervisor harness. Auto-dispatches role-based subagents (designer, executors, verifier, rule-applier) with Ralph loop, retry budget, and project-defined domain executors.

plugins.name: panma-hud
plugins.description: Heads-up display for Claude Code. A statusline script showing session info (model, cwd, ctx%, cost) plus live panma-harness cycle state (phase, workers, retries, STOP) when .harness/state.json is present.
